In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], there was a '''skirmish''' on [[Orsis Orbital Station]]. [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], her [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] warriors, and a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] battled the forces of [[Vollick/Legends|Vollick]] warlord, [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]]. In the end, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] appeared and told Maul to slaughter all in the [[Orsis Academy]].
